trust_decision.summary: Self-service profile update decides which user attributes a caller may write to their own row; at the pinned commit the route already restricts the body to user_password before UserSchema.load (the mass-assignment fix is ALREADY PRESENT). The recorded fix commit changes no security logic.

landing_point.why: UserSchema.load(jsdata, instance=user, partial=True) on the self-service profile update; the inline comment cites the CWE-915 mass-assignment report, but the allow-list is already in place at the pinned commit.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the recorded fix commit is a bumpversion revert (2.4.29 -> 2.4.28) with no source fix, so there is no published fix scope to measure against.

services: unknown (docker-compose lists db, app, worker, nginx)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: n/a: the vulnerability is already fixed at the pinned commit

out_of_scope_notes: Many other schema.load(..., instance=...) update paths exist (e.g. source/app/blueprints/manage/manage_users.py:473, source/app/datamgmt/manage/manage_users_db.py:694 setattr loop); not examined because the advisory's own fix scope is unknown.
unverified: The recorded fix commit bbffcafa only reverts version strings (fix.diff:11-12, fix.diff:82-83); the actual mass-assignment fix commit is mis-attributed and was not identified.

The self-service profile allow-list (source/app/blueprints/profile/profile_routes.py:128-141) shows the CWE-915 fix is already applied at the pinned commit; whether CVE-2026-42540 refers to this exact fix or to another route was not confirmed (advisory text not available).
regression_tests_in_pinned_commit flag is used to mean that the fix itself is already in the pinned tree; the fix diff contains no tests to compare.
Repo size, test suite and offline buildability not checked.
